chunks: God is witness there is no god but He, and so are the angels and men full of learning. He is the upholder of justice. There is no god but He, the mighty and all-wise.

key_terms.أُولُوا الْعِلْمِ: men of knowledge / those endowed with learning

ai.seo_question: Who are the witnesses to God's oneness in Surah Aal Imran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'those endowed with knowledge' (Ulu al-Alm) is frequently interpreted as referring specifically to the Ahl al-Bayt, particularly Imam Ali and the Imams, who serve as the living proof of divine truth. This verse establishes their authority not merely as scholars, but as witnesses to God's oneness and upholders of justice, linking epistemological certainty with theological and practical equity. It underscores the Shia belief that true understanding of Islam is inextricably linked to the guidance of the Infallibles.
